judgment_calls.decision: Encoded Q1 as Level of reduction in systolic blood pressure on standing >= 20 mmHg; lying and standing BP measured in a measure task. The diastolic drop >= 10 branch is not modelled (no observable for a diastolic drop, and the language cannot subtract two measurements).
